title: Pivot Monthly Seat Utilization by Customer
prompt: Your company tracks seat utilization for each customer across three subscription tiers: 'Basic', 'Pro', and 'Enterprise'. The `monthly_seat_usage` table stores one row per (customer_id, tier, month) combination, recording the number of active seats used. Pivot this data into a wide-format report showing, for each customer in March 2024, the MAXIMUM number of seats used in each tier during that month. If a customer had no usage in a tier, display 0 instead of NULL. Output columns must be: `customer_id`, `basic_seats`, `pro_seats`, `enterprise_seats`. Order the result by `customer_id` ascending. Note that some customers may have multiple usage snapshots in the same tier within March (e.g., measured daily); take the MAX across all snapshots for that tier.
schema_ddl: CREATE TABLE monthly_seat_usage (customer_id INT NOT NULL, tier VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, usage_date DATE NOT NULL, active_seats INT NOT NULL); CREATE TABLE customers (customer_id INT PRIMARY KEY, company_name VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL);
example_input_data: INSERT INTO customers (customer_id, company_name) VALUES (101, 'Acme Corp'), (102, 'Widget Inc'), (103, 'Zeta LLC'), (104, 'Beta Systems'); INSERT INTO monthly_seat_usage (customer_id, tier, usage_date, active_seats) VALUES (101, 'Basic', '2024-03-05', 10), (101, 'Pro', '2024-03-05', 25), (101, 'Pro', '2024-03-12', 30), (102, 'Enterprise', '2024-03-03', 50), (102, 'Enterprise', '2024-03-10', 55), (103, 'Basic', '2024-03-08', 5), (104, 'Pro', '2024-03-15', 8);
hints: This is a pivot operation; transform the tier names ('Basic', 'Pro', 'Enterprise') into separate columns using CASE expressions inside an aggregation.

For each tier column, use MAX(CASE WHEN tier = 'TierName' THEN active_seats END) and group by customer_id. Since the prompt requires 0 instead of NULL, wrap each column expression with COALESCE(..., 0).

The complete query is: SELECT customer_id, COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN tier = 'Basic' THEN active_seats END), 0) AS basic_seats, COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN tier = 'Pro' THEN active_seats END), 0) AS pro_seats, COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN tier = 'Enterprise' THEN active_seats END), 0) AS enterprise_seats FROM monthly_seat_usage WHERE usage_date >= '2024-03-01' AND usage_date < '2024-04-01' GROUP BY customer_id ORDER BY customer_id;
answer_key: SELECT customer_id, COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN tier = 'Basic' THEN active_seats END), 0) AS basic_seats, COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN tier = 'Pro' THEN active_seats END), 0) AS pro_seats, COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN tier = 'Enterprise' THEN active_seats END), 0) AS enterprise_seats FROM monthly_seat_usage WHERE usage_date >= '2024-03-01' AND usage_date < '2024-04-01' GROUP BY customer_id ORDER BY customer_id;

_meta.scenario: an enterprise software vendor monitoring seat utilization across customers
